name: pinevim-local
description: Private tmux workspace for interactive Pi and normal Neovim

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-themes.mjs dist/piui/themes && mkdir -p build/src && node scripts/copy-themes.mjs build/src/piui/themes
scripts.copy:themes: node scripts/copy-themes.mjs dist/piui/themes && mkdir -p build/src && node scripts/copy-themes.mjs build/src/piui/themes
scripts.format: prettier --write src tests scripts/*.mjs package.json tsconfig*.json eslint.config.js Docs/Compatibility.md Docs/Testing.md Docs/Implementation-Evidence.md README.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests scripts/*.mjs package.json tsconfig*.json eslint.config.js Docs/Compatibility.md Docs/Testing.md Docs/Implementation-Evidence.md README.md
scripts.test: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test --test-concurrency=1 build/tests/unit/*.test.js build/tests/integration/*.test.js
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test --test-concurrency=1 build/tests/integration/*.test.js
scripts.benchmark: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node scripts/benchmark.mjs
